source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Studio in the Old Barn
tts_text: Every October, the harvest brought the whole valley together. The yield from those small fields was never large, but it was enough for everyone. By the time the rice was mature, the farmers had already ploughed the next field. Farming was still the dominant way of life in the village. In the house, however, the work was different. Cooking, washing and cleaning were endless domestic chores. They were dull and tedious, and after a few hours they made anyone feel dumb. So Li Wei made a schedule. Her scheme was simple: finish the chores before noon, then work on her own project. She wrote it on the first page of her agenda and turned it into a daily routine. Her project was the old barn behind the house. She walked through the narrow passage at the back and studied the interior and the exterior. The external walls were grey stone; the internal walls were dark wood. She worked for the local paper, a small medium with a young readership. Her photographs were only of intermediate quality then, and the media paid little attention to her. Still, she had to locate a good site for a studio. She decided to allocate half her savings to the roof and to situate the darkroom in the corner near the window. When she photographed the farmers, she asked them to pose among the rice. She corrected their posture, then bent down to expose the film to the morning light.

sentences_cn: 每年十月，收割把整个山谷的人都聚到一起。
那几小块地的产量从来不高，但对每个人来说都够用了。
等稻子成熟时，农民们已经把下一块地犁好了。
在村里，种地仍然是占主导地位的生活方式。
然而，屋子里的活计就完全不同了。
做饭、洗衣、打扫，是没完没了的家务。
这些活又枯燥又乏味，干上几个钟头，谁都会觉得自己变笨了。
于是李薇给自己排了一张时间表。
她的方案很简单：中午前干完家务，然后做自己的事。
她把它写在记事本的第一页上，慢慢变成了一种日常习惯。
她的项目是屋后的旧谷仓。
她穿过后面那条窄窄的通道，仔细看了看里面和外面。
外墙是灰色的石头，内墙是深色的木头。
她给当地一家报纸干活，那是一家面向年轻读者的小媒体。
那时她的照片只算中等水平，媒体几乎没注意过她。
不过，她得先给摄影棚找一个好位置。
她决定把一半积蓄分给屋顶，把暗房安置在靠窗的角落。
给农民拍照时，她请他们站在稻田里摆姿势。
她纠正他们的姿态，然后蹲下去，让胶片在晨光中曝光。

words.cn: 收获，成果 v. 收割；采集

words.family: harvester n. 收割机

words.cn: 家庭的;本国的n. 家庭矛盾

words.family: domesticate v. 驯养 / domesticity n. 家庭生活

words.root: 靠搭配记：a dull day 无聊的一天 → 枯燥的

words.cn: 愚蠢的;哑的;无言的

words.cn: 单调的,乏味的
words.mnemonic: 发音类似：踢地而死。→这部 电影冗长乏味到让人踢地而死→乏味的。

words.root: tedi(厌烦，拉丁 taedium) + ous(……的) → 令人厌烦的
words.family: tedium n. 乏味 / tediously adv. 冗长地

words.cn: 工作计划；日程安排；(公共汽车、火车等的) 时间表；(价目、费用等的)清单，一览表 v. 安排，预定
words.mnemonic: 单词可拆分为：死(s)车(che)堵 (du)了(le)，耽误了我们的“日程安排”。
words.zhenti: The notion that as parents we need to schedule every minute of their time is not doing them a great service. 作为父母，我们需要 安排他们每一分钟的时间，这种想法对他们没 有什么好处。(2020)

words.family: scheduled adj. 预定的 / reschedule v. 重新安排

words.mnemonic: 把s想象成一个s型美女，那就 是我爱上了一个美女，为了追求她，我(me)计划 躲到美女(s)的车里(che 是车的汉语拼音)，这 是我的“计划；阴谋”。结果美女(s)在车里发现 了我，我的计划被识破了。
words.zhenti: Universities want the government to introduce a loan scheme for tuition fees. 大学 希望政府推出一项学费贷款计划。
words.sentence: Her scheme was simple
words.root: 源自希腊 schema(形状、安排) → 计划、方案
words.family: schemer n. 阴谋家 / schematic adj. 纲要的

words.cn: (会议的)议程表，议事日程
words.mnemonic: 这个单词可以拆成：a（一）十 gen(发音似“件”)+da(大)，连在一起就是“一 件大(事)”，大事当然要放在自己的日程表上→ 议程表，议事日程。
words.sentence: She wrote it on the first page of her agenda
words.root: ag(做) + enda(复数词尾) → 要做的事 → 议事日程
words.family: agent n. 代理人 / agency n. 机构

words.cn: 常规；日常工作；例行程序
words.mnemonic: 这个单词的发音类似“路听”。 很多老板行程比较满，在路上听秘书说下一个 例行安排→日常工作。
words.zhenti: What they found was that it wasn't breakfast itself that caused the participants to lose weight: it was changing their normal routine.他们发现，并不是早餐本身导致了参与 者的体重减轻，而是改变了他们的日常生活导 致的。(2019)
words.sentence: turned it into a daily routine
words.root: route(路线) + ine → 老走同一条路 → 例行公事
words.family: routinely adv. 例行地

words.cn: 通过;通路，通道；文章

words.zhenti: We can conclude from the passage that romantic love is becoming increasingly important in family relationships. 从文章中我们可以得出 结论，浪漫的爱情在家庭关系中变得越来越重 要。(2013)
words.sentence: She walked through the narrow passage at the back
words.root: pass(通过) + age(名词后缀) → 通过；通道
words.family: pass v. 通过 / passenger n. 乘客

words.family: exteriorly adv. 在外部

words.cn: 外部的

words.sentence: The external walls were grey stone

words.cn: 内部的；内政的；国内的

words.family: media n. 媒体 / mediate v. 调解

words.cn: 中等的，中间的，中级的n. 中级学生

words.zhenti: Fewer than half of Americans say they cook at an intermediate level and only 20% describe their cooking skills as advanced. 不到 一半的美国人说他们的烹饪水平是中级的，只 有20%的人说他们的烹饪技能是高级的。

words.cn: 本地人 adj. 地方性的,当地的

words.cn: (为画像、拍照等摆的)姿势 v. 摆姿势；造成；引起 (083)

words.zhenti: Or they may wish to expose their children to another culture, and the opportunity to learn a second language. 或者，他们可能希望让 孩子接触另一种文化，并有机会学习第二语言。
